scripts.build: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --log-level=warning --outfile=dist/index.cjs && node -e "fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.d.ts', 'dist/index.d.cts')"
scripts.prepack: node -e "for (const file of ['README.md', 'LICENSE']) fs.copyFileSync('../../' + file, file)"
